lines: Hello, I'm Chirithy, your personal comp... Dream Eater.
I'm to be your guide on your journey, and it's a pleasure to meet you!
Well, as I said, I'm a Dream Eater, specifically a "Spirit", but you don't need to worry about that part now anyway.
What -IS- important is I'm your companion and guide.

answers.text: That's it? I can talk to you and you answers my questions?
Alright, I'll keep that in mind. We'll talk later.

lines: That's the jist of it. Just gotta ask and I'll do my best to steer you right!
And remember. May your heart be your guiding key.
